description: Reads a flat 2D DXF (text DXF, as exported by AutoCAD, Fusion, Inventor and most CAD) and returns the parts, cut length, number of pierces and drawing problems (duplicate lines, open contours, near-miss gaps, holes smaller than the thickness). With a cutting speed it also returns the cutting time per part, including acceleration and pierces; with pricing it returns a price. Sheet nesting is not included.

cut_speed_mm_per_min.description: Cutting speed for this material and thickness

dxf.description: The DXF file content as text

machine.description: A preset name (laser, plasma, waterjet) or {accel_mm_per_s2:[x,y,z], corner_tolerance_mm}

machine_rate_per_hour.description: Machine cost per hour, for pricing

material.description: For a material cost from the part area: {density_g_cm3, price_per_kg, utilisation_percent (expected sheet use, default 70)}

pricing.description: Optional: turn the result into a price

thickness_mm.description: Material thickness, used to flag small holes

units.description: Override the drawing units if the file does not state them

name: analyse_dxf_for_cutting
title: Analyse a DXF for laser, plasma or waterjet cutting
